latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — add subtitles to videos effortlessly for creators.

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and request captions in multiple languages (e.g., English, Spanish).
- Automatic session setup with free credits for new users; no software installation required.
- Server-side GPU rendering delivers captioned, downloadable 1080p MP4 videos within 1–2 minutes.
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, and iterative workflows with timeline previews.
- Accepts a wide range of audio/video/image formats and provides concise feedback for state, balance, and errors.
- Designed for accessibility, speed, and ease-of-use for content creators posting to YouTube and social platforms.
